## Submit your proposal

Start with a question you can investigate, a dataset you can access, and an experiment you can finish with your available time and hardware.

1. **Download and fill in the YAML template.** Write a short public summary, list your teammates, and describe the dataset, approach, and evaluation plan.
2. **Send your proposal to the instructor for review**, together with your thumbnail if you have one. A simple diagram is welcome; a thumbnail is optional at this stage.
3. **Revise after feedback.** Once approved, your title, team, summary, and thumbnail can appear in this gallery. Reports and code can be linked later.

<a class="showcase-action" href="project-proposal.yml" download="project-proposal.yml">Download proposal template · YAML</a>

Use spaces for indentation and keep the field names unchanged. The comments in the template explain what to write. Choose an image you may share, include its source, and write a short description for readers who cannot see it.

Looking for the course notebooks? [Browse coding assignments and homework](../projects.qmd).
